summary: Legacy slider visual, hidden from the node picker — superseded by net.noodl.controls.range (Slider).
description: The original Range (slider) visual, kept only so old projects load. The Slider control (net.noodl.controls.range) supersedes it with min/max/step value binding, visual states and accessibility.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.controls.range instead.
runtimeBehavior: Its only dynamic ports are its Data Attributes list: each data-* name listed in `dataAttributes` becomes a string input of that name, written on the element (declared-port-groups). Every other port is static.
